evidence.title: Flexential reports its Atlanta-Douglasville facility under construction
evidence.excerpt: The August 18 issuer disclosure reports a current 36 MW Atlanta-Douglasville build. Owner address and completion-scope records identify Douglasville 2; other planned projects are excluded.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of exact content-decoded HTTP response body
metadata.publication_date_basis: August 18, 2026 09:04 ET issuer-release dateline, normalized to UTC.
metadata.observation_date_basis: Current physical-status sentence in dated issuer disclosure. August 18 is an observation, not a construction onset or a financing-only proxy.

literal_pointer.scope: Current-construction sentence and immediately following planned-only sentence; zero-based UTF-8 byte start.

metadata.identity_inference: Explicit analyst reconciliation: the owner identifies D2 at 1750 N River Road as 36 MW and its July ESG account names D2 as awaiting completion. The later August 18 issuer current-construction sentence names the 36 MW Douglasville facility. No capacity-only cross-city assignment.
metadata.phase_scope: Generic current construction on Douglasville 2 only. No exact unfinished hall, current IT capacity, workload or delivered capacity inferred.
metadata.contrary_evidence: May 2025 acquisition and undated current owner marketing describe capabilities in present tense. Neither gives a dated whole-project completion; partial operation is not excluded. The August current-work claim is not a claim that no part is operating.
metadata.explicit_exclusions: Neighboring D1, planned Norcross 2, and Parker/Hillsboro facilities are not additional Douglasville project rows.
metadata.rights_scope: Independently restated factual projection only. Source prose, source HTML, images and logos remain temporary; issuer-distributed text is not a reporter construction paraphrase.
metadata.owner_marketing_caveat: Current D2 owner web text was reviewed, including built-to-support wording. The brochure was web-readable but direct capture returned HTTP 403; no brochure hash, image review, physical date or selected evidence is claimed.
